title: QR / barcode scanner
summary: Native full-screen scanner for QR codes and, with anyFormat, every common barcode (EAN, UPC, Code 128, DataMatrix, PDF417 …).
limits: One code per scan; the scanner closes after the first hit.
Closing the scanner rejects with UserCancelledError.
example:
const qr = useConnector('qr')
const { text, format } = await qr.scan({ instructions: 'Scan the label', anyFormat: true })
